"""Run with python -m pipelines.sources.probe. Standard library only."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import bz2
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import time
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

MIB = 1024 * 1024
SEED = "corpus-s0-20261016-v1"
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def write_json(path: Path, value: object) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def read_bounded(response, maximum: int, *, prefix: bool, deadline: float) -> bytes:
    """A prefix reads exactly its cap; a whole file reads one sentinel byte."""
    chunks = []
    remaining = maximum if prefix else maximum + 1
    while remaining:
        if time.monotonic() > deadline:
            raise TimeoutError("total download deadline exceeded")
        chunk = response.read(min(65536, remaining))
        if not chunk:
            break
        chunks.append(chunk)
        remaining -= len(chunk)
    body = b"".join(chunks)
    if not prefix and len(body) > maximum:
        raise ValueError("download exceeds byte limit")
    return body


class Probe:
    def __init__(self, output: Path):
        self.output = output
        self.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.requests: list[dict] = []

    def get(self, name: str, url: str, maximum: int = 2 * MIB,
            *, prefix: bool = False, timeout: int = 90) -> tuple[bytes, dict]:
        record = {"name": name, "url": url, "maximum_bytes": maximum,
                  "prefix_requested": prefix, "socket_timeout_seconds": 60,
                  "download_deadline_seconds": timeout, "status": "failed"}
        self.requests.append(record)
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            headers = {"User-Agent": "CorpusDesktop-S0-source-qualification/0.1",
                       "Accept-Encoding": "identity"}
            if prefix:
                headers["Range"] = f"bytes=0-{maximum - 1}"
            print(f"GET {name} (cap={maximum}, deadline={timeout}s)", flush=True)
            with urlopen(Request(url, headers=headers), timeout=60) as response:
                record.update(http_status=response.status, resolved_url=response.url,
                              headers={key.lower(): value for key, value in response.headers.items()
                                       if key.lower() in {"last-modified", "etag", "content-length",
                                                          "content-range", "content-type"}})
                length = response.headers.get("Content-Length")
                if not prefix and length and int(length) > maximum:
                    raise ValueError("declared content length exceeds byte limit")
                body = read_bounded(response, maximum, prefix=prefix, deadline=started + timeout)
                if length and len(body) < min(int(length), maximum):
                    raise ValueError("truncated HTTP body")
                if not body:
                    raise ValueError("empty HTTP body")
                if prefix and response.status == 206 and not re.fullmatch(
                    rf"bytes 0-{len(body)-1}/\d+", response.headers.get("Content-Range", "")
                ):
                    raise ValueError("unexpected Content-Range")
            path = self.output / name
            path.write_bytes(body)
            record.update(status="downloaded_prefix" if prefix else "downloaded",
                          bytes=len(body), sha256=digest(body), local_file=str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),
                          checksum_scope="downloaded prefix" if prefix else "complete response body")
            return body, record
        except Exception as exc:
            record["error"] = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
            raise
        finally:
            record["elapsed_seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)

    def get_curl(self, name: str, url: str, maximum: int) -> tuple[bytes, dict]:
        """System TLS transport for slow Tatoeba files; no resume of partial files."""
        record = {"name": name, "url": url, "maximum_bytes": maximum,
                  "download_deadline_seconds": 3600, "connect_timeout_seconds": 60,
                  "status": "failed", "transport": "curl"}
        self.requests.append(record)
        path = self.output / (name + ".partial")
        headers_path = self.output / (name + ".headers")
        print(f"GET {name} with curl; progress in {name}.progress.log", flush=True)
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            with (self.output / (name + ".progress.log")).open("w") as log:
                result = subprocess.run(["curl.exe" if __import__("os").name == "nt" else "curl",
                                         "--fail", "--location", "--max-time", "3600", "--connect-timeout", "60",
                                         "--speed-limit", "1", "--speed-time", "60", "--max-filesize", str(maximum),
                                         "--user-agent", "CorpusDesktop-S0-source-qualification/0.1",
                                         "--dump-header", str(headers_path), "--output", str(path),
                                         "--write-out", "%{json}", url],
                                        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=log, timeout=3660, check=False)
            transfer = json.loads(result.stdout)
            record.update(http_status=transfer["http_code"], resolved_url=transfer["url_effective"],
                          curl_exit=result.returncode)
            if result.returncode:
                raise OSError(f"curl exit {result.returncode}; see {name}.progress.log")
            body = path.read_bytes()
            if not body or len(body) > maximum:
                raise ValueError("empty or oversized curl download")
            raw_headers = headers_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip().split("\n\n")[-1]
            headers = {line.split(":", 1)[0].lower(): line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                       for line in raw_headers.splitlines() if ":" in line}
            if "content-length" in headers and len(body) != int(headers["content-length"]):
                raise ValueError("truncated curl download")
            target = self.output / name
            path.replace(target)
            record.update(status="downloaded", bytes=len(body), sha256=digest(body),
                          checksum_scope="complete response body", headers=headers,
                          local_file=str(target.relative_to(ROOT)))
            return body, record
        except Exception as exc:
            record["error"] = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
            raise
        finally:
            record["elapsed_seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)


def unpack_bz2(data: bytes, *, prefix: bool = False, maximum: int = 32 * MIB) -> bytes:
    decompressor = bz2.BZ2Decompressor()
    output = decompressor.decompress(data, max_length=maximum + 1)
    if len(output) > maximum:
        raise ValueError("decompressed data exceeds byte limit")
    if not prefix and not decompressor.eof:
        raise ValueError("incomplete bzip2 file")
    return output if not prefix else output.rsplit(b"\n", 1)[0] + b"\n"


def parse_detailed(data: bytes, language: str) -> dict[int, dict]:
    result = {}
    for line in data.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
        fields = line.split("\t")
        if len(fields) != 6 or fields[1] != language:
            raise ValueError("invalid detailed sentence row")
        sentence_id = int(fields[0])
        if sentence_id in result:
            raise ValueError("duplicate sentence ID")
        result[sentence_id] = {"id": sentence_id, "language": language, "text": fields[2],
                               "owner": fields[3], "added": fields[4], "modified": fields[5],
                               "attribution_url": f"https://tatoeba.org/en/sentences/show/{sentence_id}"}
    return result


def select_pairs(links: bytes, chinese: dict, english: dict, count: int = 10000) -> tuple[list, int]:
    eligible = set()
    for line in links.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
        source_id, target_id = map(int, line.split("\t"))
        if source_id in chinese and target_id in english:
            eligible.add((source_id, target_id))
    ranked = sorted(eligible, key=lambda pair: (digest(f"{SEED}:{pair[0]}:{pair[1]}".encode()), pair))
    return ranked[:count], len(eligible)


def tatoeba(probe: Probe) -> dict:
    base = "https://downloads.tatoeba.org/exports/per_language/"
    chinese, cmn_record = probe.get_curl("cmn_sentences_detailed.tsv.bz2", base + "cmn/cmn_sentences_detailed.tsv.bz2", 4 * MIB)
    links, links_record = probe.get_curl("cmn-eng_links.tsv.bz2", base + "cmn/cmn-eng_links.tsv.bz2", 2 * MIB)
    english, eng_record = probe.get_curl("eng_sentences_detailed.tsv.bz2", base + "eng/eng_sentences_detailed.tsv.bz2", 40 * MIB)
    probe.get("tatoeba-downloads.html", "https://tatoeba.org/en/downloads")
    probe.get("tatoeba-cmn-index.html", base + "cmn/")
    versions = {record["headers"].get("last-modified", "")[:16] for record in (cmn_record, links_record, eng_record)}
    if len(versions) != 1 or "" in versions:
        raise ValueError("Tatoeba export date mismatch; retry a stable weekly export")
    cmn = parse_detailed(unpack_bz2(chinese), "cmn")
    eng = parse_detailed(unpack_bz2(english, maximum=256 * MIB), "eng")
    pairs, population = select_pairs(unpack_bz2(links), cmn, eng)
    if len(pairs) < 10000:
        raise ValueError("fewer than 10000 direct bilingual sample pairs")
    rows = [{"edge_id": f"tatoeba:{a}:{b}", "source": cmn[a], "target": eng[b],
             "relation": "upstream_direct_link", "license": "CC-BY-2.0-FR"} for a, b in pairs]
    write_json(probe.output / "tatoeba-sample.json", rows)
    return {"status": "sample_downloaded", "version": next(iter(versions)),
            "identity": {r["name"]: r["sha256"] for r in (cmn_record, links_record, eng_record)},
            "sample_seed": SEED, "sample_method": "lowest SHA256(seed:cmn_id:eng_id) from unique eligible direct links",
            "sample_scope": "complete cmn and eng detailed files joined to complete direct cmn-eng links; deterministic 10000-pair development sample, not a balanced corpus",
            "eligible_pair_count": population, "sample_pair_count": len(pairs), "pair_ids": pairs,
            "available_cmn_sentences": len(cmn), "available_eng_sentences": len(eng),
            "publisher_checksum": "not present in inspected directory; local SHA256 records acquired bytes only",
            "license_record": "CC BY 2.0 FR per official downloads page; sentence owner and URL preserved; CC0 subset not assumed",
            "release_approved": False, "model_egress": "not_approved", "full_corpus_downloaded": False}


def wikimedia(probe: Probe, wiki: str) -> dict:
    release = "2026-10-01"
    base = f"https://dumps.wikimedia.org/other/mediawiki_content_current/{wiki}/{release}/xml/bzip2/"
    sums, sums_record = probe.get(f"{wiki}-SHA256SUMS", base + "SHA256SUMS", 4 * MIB)
    files = parse_sha256sums(sums, base, wiki, release)
    chosen = min(files, key=lambda item: item["name"])
    data, _ = probe.get(f"{wiki}-articles.prefix.bz2", chosen["url"], 65536, prefix=True)
    if not data.startswith(b"BZh"):
        raise ValueError("download is not bzip2")
    return {"status": "download_prefix_verified", "version": release, "files": files,
            "dataset": "mediawiki_content_current", "chosen_probe_file": chosen["name"], "publisher_sha256": chosen["sha256"],
            "checksum_manifest_sha256": sums_record["sha256"], "publisher_checksum_verified": False,
            "checksum_note": "SHA256SUMS existence marks completed monthly export. Only 64 KiB downloaded; full-file SHA256 remains unverified.",
            "namespace_filter": [0], "current_revisions_only": True,
            "license_record": "Wikimedia Terms of Use section 7; CC BY-SA 4.0/GFDL where applicable; page-specific exceptions require retention",
            "attribution_fields_required": ["wiki", "page_id", "title", "revision_id", "revision_url", "history_url", "license", "modifications"],
            "release_approved": False, "model_egress": "not_approved", "full_corpus_downloaded": False}


def parse_sha256sums(body: bytes, base: str, wiki: str, release: str) -> list[dict]:
    files = []
    for line in body.decode().splitlines():
        checksum, name = line.split(maxsplit=1)
        name = name.lstrip("*")
        name = name.removeprefix("./")
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", checksum) or not re.fullmatch(rf"{wiki}-{release}-[A-Za-z0-9-]+\.xml\.bz2", name):
            raise ValueError("invalid publisher checksum entry")
        files.append({"name": name, "sha256": checksum, "url": urljoin(base, name)})
    if not files or len({f["name"] for f in files}) != len(files):
        raise ValueError("empty or duplicate publisher checksum entries")
    return files


def ud(probe: Probe) -> dict:
    repository = "UniversalDependencies/UD_Chinese-GSD"
    tag = "r2.18"
    # Resolved using official git ls-remote on 2026-10-16; pinned in registry.json.
    commit = "e0d85a020182e264d6384be2a59c0f4879a1cc35"
    base = f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{repository}/{commit}/"
    readme, _ = probe.get("ud-README.md", base + "README.md")
    license_body, _ = probe.get("ud-LICENSE.txt", base + "LICENSE.txt")
    data, record = probe.get("zh_gsd-ud-test.conllu", base + "zh_gsd-ud-test.conllu", 4 * MIB)
    ids = re.findall(r"^# sent_id = (.+)$", data.decode(), flags=re.MULTILINE)
    if not ids or len(ids) != len(set(ids)) or "Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0" not in license_body.decode():
        raise ValueError("invalid UD sample or unexpected license")
    if "not the underlying content" not in readme.decode():
        raise ValueError("UD underlying-content caveat changed; review required")
    return {"status": "sample_downloaded_license_review_required", "version": tag, "commit": commit,
            "sample_file": record["url"], "sample_sha256": record["sha256"], "sentence_count": len(ids),
            "sentence_ids": ids, "language": "zh-Hant", "license_record": "CC BY-SA 4.0 for UD annotations; Google does not claim copyright in underlying text",
            "attribution": ["Mo Shen", "Ryan McDonald", "Daniel Zeman", "Peng Qi", "Universal Dependencies Chinese-GSD"],
            "release_approved": False, "model_egress": "not_approved", "full_treebank_downloaded": False,
            "blocking_review": "Confirm underlying text rights or approve an alternative UD treebank before public release"}


def ud_gum(probe: Probe) -> dict:
    repository = "UniversalDependencies/UD_English-GUM"
    commit = "b58e74bc22d17220c9198864c253a50a897bf27f"
    base = f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{repository}/{commit}/"
    readme, _ = probe.get("gum-README.md", base + "README.md")
    license_body, license_record = probe.get("gum-LICENSE.txt", base + "LICENSE.txt")
    if b"NonCommercial" not in license_body or b"License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0" not in readme:
        raise ValueError("GUM licensing changed; review required")
    data, record = probe.get("en_gum-ud-test.conllu", base + "en_gum-ud-test.conllu", 16 * MIB)
    ids = re.findall(r"^# sent_id = (.+)$", data.decode(), flags=re.MULTILINE)
    if not ids or len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
        raise ValueError("invalid GUM sentence IDs")
    return {"status": "alternative_sample_downloaded_license_review_required", "version": "r2.18",
            "commit": commit, "sample_sha256": record["sha256"], "sentence_count": len(ids),
            "sentence_ids": ids, "license_file_sha256": license_record["sha256"],
            "license_record": "CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; LICENSE describes underlying sources and separate Reddit data not included in this repository",
            "attribution": "Original text sources and GUM annotators; Zeldes (2017), The GUM Corpus; preserve document meta::author and meta::sourceURL",
            "blocking_review": "Confirm intended deployment meets NonCommercial and ShareAlike conditions, or select another reviewed treebank",
            "release_approved": False, "model_egress": "not_approved", "full_treebank_downloaded": False}


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=ROOT / "tmp/sources-s0" / datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ"))
    parser.add_argument("--source", choices=["all", "tatoeba", "zhwiki", "enwiki", "ud", "gum"], default="all")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output = args.output.resolve()
    if not output.is_relative_to(ROOT / "tmp" / "sources-s0"):
        parser.error("output must stay inside repository tmp/sources-s0")
    probe = Probe(output)
    results = {"schema": "source-qualification/v1", "observed_at_utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
               "stage": "S0", "publication_state": "NOT_PUBLISHED", "sources": {}, "requests": probe.requests}
    tasks = {"tatoeba": tatoeba, "zhwiki": lambda p: wikimedia(p, "zhwiki"),
             "enwiki": lambda p: wikimedia(p, "enwiki"), "ud": ud, "gum": ud_gum}
    for name, task in tasks.items():
        if args.source not in {"all", name}:
            continue
        try:
            results["sources"][name] = task(probe)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 -- CLI must persist failed acquisition evidence.
            results["sources"][name] = {"status": "blocked", "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}", "release_approved": False}
        write_json(output / "manifest.json", results)
        print(f"{name}: {results['sources'][name]['status']}", flush=True)
    print(str(output / "manifest.json"))
    return int(any(s["status"] == "blocked" for s in results["sources"].values()))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""One bounded recovery experiment for the fixed October 2026 English shard."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import http.client
import json
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

from .probe import MIB, ROOT, parse_sha256sums, write_json
from .wiki_shard import (
    BASE,
    MAXIMUM,
    NAME,
    file_sha256,
    response_headers,
    verify_sample,
)

OLD = ROOT / "tmp/sources-s0/20261016-enwiki-sample"
DEFAULT = ROOT / "tmp/sources-s0/20261016-enwiki-ranges"
CHUNK = 64 * MIB
TOTAL = 2_154_933_323
DEADLINE = 21600
SEGMENT_DEADLINE = 900


class VersionMismatch(ValueError):
    pass


def validate_response(status, headers, start, end, expected):
    wanted = {"Content-Range": f"bytes {start}-{end}/{TOTAL}", "Content-Length": str(end - start + 1),
              "ETag": expected["etag"], "Last-Modified": expected["last-modified"]}
    if status != 206 or any(headers.get(k) != value for k, value in wanted.items()):
        raise VersionMismatch("range status, byte positions, total length or version mismatch")


def read_body(response, path, size, state, attempt, started, clock=time.monotonic):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("xb") as stream:
        while attempt["bytes"] < size:
            if clock() - started > SEGMENT_DEADLINE or clock() > state["deadline_monotonic"]:
                raise TimeoutError("range or experiment deadline exceeded")
            chunk = response.read(min(MIB, size - attempt["bytes"]))
            if not chunk:
                raise OSError("incomplete range body")
            state["network_bytes_received"] += len(chunk)
            attempt["bytes"] += len(chunk)
            stream.write(chunk)
            h.update(chunk)
        extra = response.read(1)
        state["network_bytes_received"] += len(extra)
        if extra:
            raise VersionMismatch("range body exceeds advertised length")
    attempt["sha256"] = h.hexdigest()


def acquire_segment(output, state, start, end, opener=urllib.request.urlopen):
    size = end - start + 1
    for number in range(2):
        if state["network_bytes_received"] + size + 1 > MAXIMUM or time.monotonic() > state["deadline_monotonic"]:
            raise ValueError("remaining experiment network/time budget insufficient")
        attempt = {"start": start, "end_inclusive": end, "attempt": number + 1, "bytes": 0,
                   "status": "requesting", "started_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()}
        path = output / f"range-{start}-{end}-attempt-{number + 1}.part"
        attempt["local_file"] = str(path.relative_to(ROOT))
        state["attempts"].append(attempt)
        write_json(output / "range-state.json", state)
        request = urllib.request.Request(BASE + NAME, headers={"Range": f"bytes={start}-{end}",
            "If-Range": state["validators"]["etag"], "User-Agent": "CorpusDesktop-S0-source-qualification/0.1"})
        try:
            started = time.monotonic()
            with opener(request, timeout=60) as response:
                attempt.update(http_status=response.status, response_headers=dict(response.headers))
                if response.geturl() != BASE + NAME:
                    raise VersionMismatch("unexpected response URL")
                validate_response(response.status, response.headers, start, end, state["validators"])
                read_body(response, path, size, state, attempt, started)
            attempt["status"] = "range_received_unverified"
            state["segments"].append(attempt.copy())
            return
        except VersionMismatch as exc:
            attempt.update(status="rejected", error=str(exc))
            raise
        except (OSError, urllib.error.URLError, http.client.IncompleteRead) as exc:
            attempt.update(status="failed", error=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
            if isinstance(exc, urllib.error.HTTPError) and exc.code < 500:
                raise
            if number == 1:
                raise
        finally:
            attempt["finished_at"] = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
            if path.exists() and "sha256" not in attempt:
                attempt["sha256"] = file_sha256(path)
            write_json(output / "range-state.json", state)
            print(json.dumps({k: attempt.get(k) for k in ("start", "end_inclusive", "attempt", "status", "bytes", "error")}), flush=True)


def download(output):
    if (output / "range-state.json").exists():
        raise ValueError("existing run found; this experiment does not automatically restart")
    old = json.loads((OLD / "transfer.json").read_text())
    tail = json.loads((OLD / "resume.json").read_text())
    headers = response_headers(output / "head.txt")
    original = response_headers(OLD / "headers.txt")
    if not (output / "head.txt").read_text().startswith("HTTP/1.1 200"):
        raise VersionMismatch("HEAD did not return 200")
    if any(headers.get(k) != original.get(k) for k in ("etag", "last-modified", "content-length")):
        raise VersionMismatch("current HEAD differs from initial version")
    if int(headers["content-length"]) != TOTAL or headers["etag"].startswith("W/"):
        raise VersionMismatch("unexpected total or weak ETag")
    sums = (output / "SHA256SUMS").read_bytes()
    selected = next(row for row in parse_sha256sums(sums, BASE, "enwiki", "2026-10-01") if row["name"] == NAME)
    if selected != old["file"] or old["status"] != "failed" or tail["status"] != "failed":
        raise VersionMismatch("old evidence is not the same failed fixed shard")
    if tail["url"] != selected["url"] or tail["etag"] != headers["etag"] or tail["last_modified"] != headers["last-modified"]:
        raise VersionMismatch("tail version mismatch")
    if tail["response_headers"]["Content-Range"] != f"bytes {tail['offset']}-{TOTAL - 1}/{TOTAL}":
        raise VersionMismatch("old tail range does not follow original partial")
    parts = [(OLD / (NAME + ".partial"), 0, tail["offset"]),
             (OLD / (NAME + ".tail"), tail["offset"], tail["bytes"])]
    prefixes = []
    for path, start, size in parts:
        if path.stat().st_size != size or size <= 0:
            raise ValueError("old prefix file size mismatch")
        prefixes.append({"start": start, "end_inclusive": start + size - 1, "bytes": size,
                         "local_file": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), "sha256": file_sha256(path),
                         "status": "reused_unverified_prefix", "original_response": "HTTP 200 partial" if start == 0 else tail["response_headers"]})
    state = {"schema": "fixed-shard-range-recovery/v1", "status": "downloading", "file": selected,
             "validators": headers, "prefixes": prefixes, "segments": [], "attempts": [],
             "network_bytes_received": len(sums), "network_byte_limit": MAXIMUM,
             "segment_bytes": CHUNK, "maximum_attempts_per_segment": 2,
             "deadline_seconds": DEADLINE, "segment_deadline_seconds": SEGMENT_DEADLINE,
             "socket_timeout_seconds": 60, "deadline_monotonic": time.monotonic() + DEADLINE,
             "started_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(), "publisher_checksum_verified": False,
             "checksum_manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256(sums).hexdigest(),
             "historical_failure_evidence": "pipelines/sources/enwiki-transfer-evidence.json"}
    write_json(output / "range-state.json", state)
    try:
        for start in range(sum(p["bytes"] for p in prefixes), TOTAL, CHUNK):
            acquire_segment(output, state, start, min(start + CHUNK, TOTAL) - 1)
        state["status"] = "all_ranges_received_unverified"
    except Exception as exc:
        state.update(status="failed", error=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
        raise
    finally:
        state["finished_at"] = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
        write_json(output / "range-state.json", state)


def assemble(output):
    state = json.loads((output / "range-state.json").read_text())
    if state["status"] != "all_ranges_received_unverified":
        raise ValueError("all ranges must complete before assembly")
    target = output / NAME
    cursor, whole = 0, hashlib.sha256()
    with target.open("xb") as dest:
        for item in state["prefixes"] + state["segments"]:
            path = (ROOT / item["local_file"]).resolve()
            if not path.is_relative_to(ROOT / "tmp/sources-s0") or item["start"] != cursor:
                raise ValueError("source path or contiguous range mismatch")
            part, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
            with path.open("rb") as stream:
                for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(MIB), b""):
                    size += len(chunk)
                    if cursor + size > TOTAL:
                        raise ValueError("assembled file exceeds expected size")
                    dest.write(chunk)
                    part.update(chunk)
                    whole.update(chunk)
            if size != item["bytes"] or item["end_inclusive"] != cursor + size - 1 or part.hexdigest() != item["sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("stored part integrity mismatch")
            cursor += size
    if cursor != TOTAL or whole.hexdigest() != state["file"]["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("full publisher SHA256 or total mismatch; no sample may be generated")
    state.update(status="assembled_publisher_verified", publisher_checksum_verified=True, assembled_sha256=whole.hexdigest())
    write_json(output / "range-state.json", state)
    checksum = {"status": "downloaded", "name": "enwiki-SHA256SUMS", "url": BASE + "SHA256SUMS",
                "local_file": str((output / "SHA256SUMS").relative_to(ROOT)), "bytes": (output / "SHA256SUMS").stat().st_size,
                "sha256": state["checksum_manifest_sha256"], "checksum_scope": "complete response body"}
    write_json(output / "transfer.json", {"status": "downloaded_unverified", "file": state["file"], "bytes": TOTAL,
               "checksum_request": checksum, "transfer": {"http_code": None}, "range_assembly": {
                   "method": "original contiguous unverified prefix plus exact validator-checked bounded HTTP ranges; final whole publisher SHA256 verified",
                   "evidence_file": str((output / "range-state.json").relative_to(ROOT)),
                   "prefixes": state["prefixes"], "segments": state["segments"], "attempts": state["attempts"]}})
    state["sample_status"] = "parsing"
    write_json(output / "range-state.json", state)
    try:
        verify_sample(output)
        state["sample_status"] = "completed"
    except Exception as exc:
        state.update(sample_status="failed", sample_error=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
        raise
    finally:
        write_json(output / "range-state.json", state)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--phase", choices=["download", "verify-sample"], required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=DEFAULT)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output = args.output.resolve()
    if not output.is_relative_to(ROOT / "tmp/sources-s0"):
        raise ValueError("output outside sources experiment directory")
    try:
        (download if args.phase == "download" else assemble)(output)
    except Exception as exc:
        write_json(output / f"{args.phase}-error.json", {"status": "failed", "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
                   "observed_at_utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(), "sample_generated_by_this_attempt": False})
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Select a fixed article sample from one fully verified current export shard."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import bz2
import heapq
import json
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

from .probe import MIB, ROOT, SEED, Probe, digest, parse_sha256sums, write_json


class LimitedReader:
    def __init__(self, stream, maximum=1024 * MIB, seconds=300):
        self.stream, self.maximum = stream, maximum
        self.read_bytes = 0
        self.deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds

    def read(self, size=-1):
        if time.monotonic() > self.deadline:
            raise TimeoutError("XML parsing deadline exceeded")
        body = self.stream.read(min(65536, size if size >= 0 else 65536))
        self.read_bytes += len(body)
        if self.read_bytes > self.maximum:
            raise ValueError("expanded XML exceeds byte limit")
        return body


def select_articles(stream, wiki: str, count=1000):
    candidates = 0
    selected = []
    context = ET.iterparse(stream, events=("start", "end"))
    _, root = next(context)
    namespace = root.tag.split("}")[0] + "}" if "}" in root.tag else ""
    q = lambda name: namespace + name
    for event, page in context:
        if event != "end" or page.tag != q("page"):
            continue
        revision = page.find(q("revision"))
        if page.findtext(q("ns")) == "0" and page.find(q("redirect")) is None and revision is not None:
            text = revision.findtext(q("text"))
            if text and text.strip():
                page_id, revision_id = int(page.findtext(q("id"))), int(revision.findtext(q("id")))
                candidates += 1
                rank = int(digest(f"{SEED}:{page_id}:{revision_id}".encode()), 16)
                row = {"wiki": wiki, "page_id": page_id, "revision_id": revision_id,
                       "title": page.findtext(q("title")), "text": text,
                       "revision_url": f"https://{wiki[:-4]}.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid={revision_id}",
                       "history_url": f"https://{wiki[:-4]}.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?curid={page_id}&action=history",
                       "license": "Wikimedia Terms of Use section 7; page-specific exceptions remain to be reviewed",
                       "modifications": "raw wikitext retained; no text cleaning applied"}
                item = (-rank, -page_id, -revision_id, row)
                if len(selected) < count:
                    heapq.heappush(selected, item)
                elif item[:3] > selected[0][:3]:
                    heapq.heapreplace(selected, item)
        root.remove(page)
    return [item[3] for item in sorted(selected, reverse=True)], candidates


def validate_receipt(path: Path, wiki: str, receipt: dict | None = None) -> Path:
    path = path.resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(ROOT / "tmp/sources-s0"):
        raise ValueError("receipt outside source output directory")
    if receipt is not None:
        file = receipt["file"]
        base = f"https://dumps.wikimedia.org/other/mediawiki_content_current/{wiki}/2026-10-01/xml/bzip2/"
        files = parse_sha256sums(f'{file["sha256"]}  {file["name"]}'.encode(), base, wiki, "2026-10-01")
        if file["url"] != files[0]["url"] or receipt["request"]["url"] != file["url"]:
            raise ValueError("receipt wiki, version or URL mismatch")
    return path


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("download_receipt", type=Path, nargs="?", default=ROOT / "tmp/sources-s0/20261016-zhwiki-sample/download.json")
    parser.add_argument("--wiki", choices=["zhwiki", "enwiki"], required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--download", action="store_true", help="Download the fixed 28MB Chinese tail shard with its official checksum")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.download_receipt = validate_receipt(args.download_receipt, args.wiki)
    if args.download:
        if args.wiki != "zhwiki":
            raise ValueError("English shards exceed this experiment's 100MiB cap")
        probe = Probe(args.download_receipt.resolve().parent)
        base = "https://dumps.wikimedia.org/other/mediawiki_content_current/zhwiki/2026-10-01/xml/bzip2/"
        sums, checksum_request = probe.get("zhwiki-SHA256SUMS", base + "SHA256SUMS")
        selected = next(f for f in parse_sha256sums(sums, base, "zhwiki", "2026-10-01")
                        if f["name"] == "zhwiki-2026-10-01-p9590059p9623184.xml.bz2")
        _, request = probe.get_curl(selected["name"], selected["url"], 100 * MIB)
        if request["sha256"] != selected["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("complete shard publisher SHA256 mismatch")
        write_json(args.download_receipt, {"file": selected, "request": request,
                                          "checksum_request": checksum_request, "publisher_checksum_verified": True})
    receipt = json.loads(args.download_receipt.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    validate_receipt(args.download_receipt, args.wiki, receipt)
    path = (ROOT / receipt["request"]["local_file"]).resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(ROOT / "tmp/sources-s0"):
        raise ValueError("download outside source output directory")
    body = path.read_bytes()
    if len(body) > 100 * MIB or digest(body) != receipt["file"]["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("complete shard publisher SHA256 mismatch or size limit")
    with bz2.open(path, "rb") as stream:
        articles, candidates = select_articles(LimitedReader(stream), args.wiki)
    if len(articles) < 1000:
        raise ValueError(f"only {len(articles)} eligible articles; 1000 required")
    sample_path = path.parent / "articles.json"
    write_json(sample_path, articles)
    result = {"status": "sample_downloaded", "dataset": "mediawiki_content_current", "version": "2026-10-01",
              "sample_article_count": len(articles), "eligible_article_count": candidates,
              "sample_seed": SEED, "sample_method": "lowest SHA256(seed:page_id:revision_id) from one fixed shard",
              "sample_scope": "biased tail-shard development sample; not corpus-wide random sample",
              "sample_ids": [[a["page_id"], a["revision_id"]] for a in articles],
              "sample_sha256": digest(sample_path.read_bytes()), "sample_file": str(sample_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
              "shard": receipt["file"], "publisher_checksum_verified": True,
              "namespace_filter": [0], "redirects_excluded": True, "text_format": "raw wikitext; cleaning map pending",
              "release_approved": False, "model_egress": "not_approved", "full_corpus_downloaded": False}
    write_json(path.parent / "manifest.json", {"schema": "source-qualification/v1",
               "observed_at_utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(), "sources": {args.wiki: result},
               "requests": ([receipt["checksum_request"]] if "checksum_request" in receipt else []) + [receipt["request"]]})
    print(f"Verified complete shard and selected {len(articles)} of {candidates} articles")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Stream the fixed English current shard to disk; hash and parse in a later CPU phase."""
import argparse
import bz2
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import time
import urllib.request
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

from .probe import MIB, ROOT, Probe, parse_sha256sums, write_json
from .wiki_sample import LimitedReader, select_articles

NAME = "enwiki-2026-10-01-p43486390p48278244.xml.bz2"
BASE = "https://dumps.wikimedia.org/other/mediawiki_content_current/enwiki/2026-10-01/xml/bzip2/"
MAXIMUM = 2560 * MIB


def response_headers(path: Path):
    return {key.strip().lower(): value.strip() for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
            if ":" in line for key, value in [line.split(":", 1)]}


def resume_once(output: Path):
    """One explicitly requested recovery of this fixed shard; never restart automatically."""
    record = json.loads((output / "transfer.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if record["status"] != "failed" or record["file"]["url"] != BASE + NAME:
        raise ValueError("expected failed fixed-shard transfer")
    partial = output / (NAME + ".partial")
    tail = output / (NAME + ".tail")
    receipt = output / "resume.json"
    if receipt.exists() or tail.exists():
        raise ValueError("one recovery attempt already exists; inspect evidence instead of retrying")
    original = response_headers(output / "headers.txt")
    head = response_headers(output / "resume-head.txt")
    if any(original.get(k) != head.get(k) for k in ("etag", "last-modified", "content-length")):
        raise ValueError("HEAD version differs from original transfer")
    total = int(original["content-length"])
    offset = partial.stat().st_size
    if not original.get("etag") or original["etag"].startswith("W/") or not 0 < offset < total <= MAXIMUM:
        raise ValueError("invalid version validator or byte bounds")
    state = {"status": "downloading_tail", "offset": offset, "total": total, "etag": original["etag"],
             "last_modified": original["last-modified"], "url": BASE + NAME,
             "deadline_seconds": 21600, "socket_timeout_seconds": 60,
             "started_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(), "bytes": 0}
    write_json(receipt, state)
    started = time.monotonic()
    request = urllib.request.Request(BASE + NAME, headers={"Range": f"bytes={offset}-", "If-Range": original["etag"],
                                                        "User-Agent": "CorpusDesktop-S0-source-qualification/0.1"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response:
            expected_range = f"bytes {offset}-{total - 1}/{total}"
            if response.status != 206 or response.headers.get("Content-Range") != expected_range:
                raise ValueError("server did not honor exact continuation range")
            if response.headers.get("ETag") != original["etag"] or response.headers.get("Last-Modified") != original["last-modified"]:
                raise ValueError("range response version mismatch")
            state["response_headers"] = dict(response.headers)
            with tail.open("xb") as stream:
                while chunk := response.read(MIB):
                    state["bytes"] += len(chunk)
                    if state["bytes"] > total - offset or time.monotonic() - started > 21600:
                        raise ValueError("continuation exceeds byte/time limit")
                    stream.write(chunk)
                    write_json(receipt, state)
            if state["bytes"] != total - offset:
                raise ValueError("incomplete range body")
        state["status"] = "tail_downloaded_unverified"
    except Exception as exc:
        state.update(status="failed", error=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
        raise
    finally:
        state["finished_at"] = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
        write_json(receipt, state)


def assemble_tail(output: Path, record: dict):
    state = json.loads((output / "resume.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    partial, tail, target = (output / (NAME + suffix) for suffix in (".partial", ".tail", ""))
    if state["status"] != "tail_downloaded_unverified" or partial.stat().st_size != state["offset"] or tail.stat().st_size != state["total"] - state["offset"]:
        raise ValueError("resume artifacts incomplete")
    with target.open("xb") as dest:
        for source in (partial, tail):
            with source.open("rb") as stream:
                for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(MIB), b""):
                    dest.write(chunk)
    record.update(status="downloaded_unverified", bytes=target.stat().st_size, recovery="one verified If-Range/206 continuation; original pieces retained")
    write_json(output / "transfer.json", record)


def file_sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(MIB), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def download(output: Path):
    probe = Probe(output)
    sums, checksum = probe.get("enwiki-SHA256SUMS", BASE + "SHA256SUMS")
    selected = next(f for f in parse_sha256sums(sums, BASE, "enwiki", "2026-10-01") if f["name"] == NAME)
    partial = output / (NAME + ".partial")
    if partial.exists() or (output / NAME).exists():
        raise ValueError("existing shard or partial found; inspect its process and evidence before any restart")
    record = {"file": selected, "checksum_request": checksum, "maximum_bytes": MAXIMUM,
              "deadline_seconds": 21600, "status": "downloading", "started_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
              "publisher_checksum_verified": False}
    write_json(output / "transfer.json", record)
    print(f"Downloading {NAME}; progress: {output / 'progress.log'}", flush=True)
    try:
        with (output / "progress.log").open("w") as log:
            result = subprocess.run(["curl.exe", "--fail", "--location", "--max-time", "21600",
                                     "--connect-timeout", "60", "--speed-time", "60", "--speed-limit", "1",
                                     "--max-filesize", str(MAXIMUM), "--user-agent", "CorpusDesktop-S0-source-qualification/0.1",
                                     "--dump-header", str(output / "headers.txt"), "--output", str(partial),
                                     "--write-out", "%{json}", selected["url"]], stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                    stderr=log, timeout=21660, check=False)
        record["transfer"] = json.loads(result.stdout)
        record["curl_exit"] = result.returncode
        if result.returncode or not partial.exists() or not 0 < partial.stat().st_size <= MAXIMUM:
            raise OSError(f"download failed; curl={result.returncode}; see progress.log")
        if partial.stat().st_size != int(record["transfer"]["size_download"]):
            raise ValueError("download size mismatch")
        partial.replace(output / NAME)
        record.update(status="downloaded_unverified", bytes=(output / NAME).stat().st_size)
    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
        record.update(status="failed", error=str(exc))
        raise
    finally:
        record["finished_at"] = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
        write_json(output / "transfer.json", record)
    print("Download complete; publisher SHA256 and sample are still pending.")


def verify_sample(output: Path):
    record = json.loads((output / "transfer.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if record["status"] == "failed" and (output / "resume.json").exists():
        assemble_tail(output, record)
    if record["status"] != "downloaded_unverified" or record["file"]["name"] != NAME or record["file"]["url"] != BASE + NAME:
        raise ValueError("expected complete fixed English shard transfer")
    path = output / NAME
    if path.stat().st_size != record["bytes"] or path.stat().st_size > MAXIMUM:
        raise ValueError("shard size mismatch")
    print("Streaming full-file SHA256...", flush=True)
    checksum = file_sha256(path)
    if checksum != record["file"]["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("publisher SHA256 mismatch")
    print("Publisher SHA256 verified; parsing entire shard with 32GiB/1800s expansion limits...", flush=True)
    with bz2.open(path, "rb") as stream:
        articles, population = select_articles(LimitedReader(stream, maximum=32768 * MIB, seconds=1800), "enwiki")
    if len(articles) != 1000:
        raise ValueError("insufficient eligible English articles")
    sample = output / "articles.json"
    write_json(sample, articles)
    source = {"status": "sample_downloaded", "dataset": "mediawiki_content_current", "version": "2026-10-01",
              "sample_article_count": len(articles), "eligible_article_count": population,
              "sample_seed": "corpus-s0-20261016-v1",
              "sample_method": "lowest SHA256(seed:page_id:revision_id) across ALL eligible pages in one fixed complete shard",
              "sample_scope": "one selected shard; not corpus-wide random sample",
              "sample_ids": [[a["page_id"], a["revision_id"]] for a in articles],
              "sample_sha256": file_sha256(sample), "sample_file": str(sample.relative_to(ROOT)),
              "shard": record["file"], "publisher_checksum_verified": True, "namespace_filter": [0],
              "redirects_excluded": True, "text_format": "raw wikitext; cleaning not yet run",
              "release_approved": False, "model_egress": "not_approved", "full_corpus_downloaded": False,
              "expanded_bytes_limit": 32768 * MIB, "parse_deadline_seconds": 1800,
              "xml_storage": "streamed through bz2 and iterparse; whole XML not written; retained memory includes current page and 1000 selected pages"}
    request = {"status": "downloaded", "name": NAME, "url": BASE + NAME, "local_file": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),
               "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": checksum, "checksum_scope": "complete downloaded file",
               "maximum_bytes": MAXIMUM, "http_status": record["transfer"]["http_code"],
               "publisher_checksum_verified": True, "record_kind": "verified_local_artifact"}
    if record.get("range_assembly"):
        request.update(http_status=None, assembly=record["range_assembly"])
    if record.get("recovery"):
        recovery = json.loads((output / "resume.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        request.update(http_status=None, assembly="ordered original partial + independently downloaded If-Range tail",
                       network_attempts=[
                           {"http_status": record["transfer"]["http_code"], "curl_exit": record["curl_exit"],
                            "status": "failed_partial", "bytes": recovery["offset"], "error": record.get("error")},
                           {"http_status": 206, "status": recovery["status"], "bytes": recovery["bytes"],
                            "content_range": recovery["response_headers"]["Content-Range"],
                            "etag": recovery["etag"], "last_modified": recovery["last_modified"]}])
    write_json(output / "manifest.json", {"schema": "source-qualification/v1", "sources": {"enwiki": source},
               "observed_at_utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(), "requests": [record["checksum_request"], request]})
    print(f"Complete shard verified; {len(articles)} samples from {population} eligible articles.")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=ROOT / "tmp/sources-s0/20261016-enwiki-sample")
    parser.add_argument("--phase", choices=["download", "resume-once", "verify-sample"], default="download")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output = args.output.resolve()
    if not output.is_relative_to(ROOT / "tmp/sources-s0"):
        raise ValueError("output outside source experiment directory")
    try:
        {"download": download, "resume-once": resume_once, "verify-sample": verify_sample}[args.phase](output)
    except Exception as exc:
        write_json(output / f"{args.phase}-error.json", {"phase": args.phase, "status": "failed",
                   "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}", "observed_at_utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
                   "sample_generated_by_this_attempt": False})
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
